value.name: Daniel meets Asha in the front hall
value.description: Daniel encounters Asha in the Serrano row house's front hall before the estate inventory begins.
evidence: In the front hall, Daniel meets Asha beside stacked banker boxes and a folder of probate papers before the formal inventory begins.
value.location_hint: front hall of the Serrano row house

value.name: Daniel urges immediate sale
value.description: Daniel argues that the house must be sold quickly because every day it remains unsold costs money.
evidence: Daniel: Asha, we can't afford to linger on nostalgia; every day this house sits unsold is just more money down the drain.
value.location_hint: front hall of the Serrano row house

value.name: Asha insists on honoring Lucia's feelings
value.description: Asha pushes back against haste, saying Lucia's feelings and the implications of selling the home must be considered.
evidence: Asha: I understand your urgency, Daniel, but we must honor Lucia's feelings and the potential implications of selling this home before rushing into a decision.
value.location_hint: front hall of the Serrano row house

value.name: Daniel dismisses Lucia's feelings
value.description: Daniel rejects Lucia's emotional concerns and insists the estate matter should be resolved pragmatically.
evidence: Daniel: Lucia's feelings are irrelevant if we want to resolve this estate matter quickly; we need to be practical and move forward.
value.location_hint: front hall of the Serrano row house

value.name: Asha warns of family rifts
value.description: Asha argues that ignoring the family's emotional ties could deepen conflict and create complications.
evidence: Asha: But practicality cannot overshadow the emotional ties that bind this family; overlooking Lucia's perspective could lead to deeper rifts and complications we can't afford.
value.location_hint: front hall of the Serrano row house

value.name: Daniel refuses to play therapist
value.description: Daniel says he is focused on survival and will not let sentimentality derail the family's future.
evidence: Daniel: Asha, with all due respect, I'm not here to play therapist; this is about survival for us, and I refuse to let sentimental attachments derail our future.
value.location_hint: front hall of the Serrano row house

value.name: Asha warns of escalating conflict
value.description: Asha cautions that failing to address the emotional situation could ignite conflict and threaten the family's unity and the sale.
evidence: Asha: I appreciate your perspective, Daniel, but without addressing the emotional landscape, we risk igniting a conflict that could jeopardize not just this sale, but the family's unity as well.
value.location_hint: front hall of the Serrano row house

value.name: Daniel demands help selling the house
value.description: Daniel insists Asha help him ignore emotional distractions and push the house sale through quickly.
evidence: Daniel: We can’t afford unity if it means dragging this process out; I need you to help me cut through the emotional noise and get this house sold, before it costs us even more.
